profile.en: She is a seasoned Taimanin who specializes in dangerous solo infiltration missions. Her combat abilities are also high; she wields ninjutsu and wood-style techniques. Known as "Shizuru of the Flowers." She manipulates plants, carries no weapons, and summons a powerful rose-whip from her palm in battle. While teaching English at Gosha Academy, she also undertakes infiltration missions at Yomihara, showing a wide range of activities. Even without her usual allure, when she changes into a swimsuit she radiates overwhelming beauty and sex appeal, captivating men. To the young students of Gosha Academy, her appearance is more than a visual poison, and Shizuru is eagerly anticipated each summer for her striking swimsuit look.
